explanation_summary: The model predicted the class glioma_tumor with a probability of 1.00. Explanation methods referenced include gradcam (ViT Grad-CAM on reshaped patch tokens), chefer_attribution (Chefer Transformer Attribution), integrated_gradients (positive-channel evidence relative to a baseline), and occlusion (signed probability change when masking regions). Because neither the original MRI nor XAI heatmap images were included, visual feature visualisations could not be inspected.
